title: refactor: simplify quest reward grants
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the public coupon-code entry, redemption route, KV registry, and coupon tests
- Keeps the authenticated admin grant endpoint and campaign-based accounting
- Keeps non-catalog grants visible as claimable Bonus rewards through the existing quest claim flow
- Reduces the follow-up by 330 lines

Checks:
- `npx biome check`
- `npx tsc --noEmit`
- `npm run build:frontend`
- `npx vitest run test/quest-grants.test.ts test/quests.test.ts --reporter=dot` (32 tests)

gist.headline: Bonus rewards, one garden
gist.blurb: Quest rewards have one less side path to wander down. Admin grants now surface as claimable Bonus rewards right in the familiar quest flow.
gist.summary: Removed the public coupon-code redemption system and its KV registry while retaining authenticated admin grants and campaign accounting, with non-catalog grants continuing to appear as claimable Bonus rewards in quests.
gist.impact: People receiving an admin-issued reward can claim it through the existing quest interface instead of using a separate public coupon redemption route.
gist.visual_concept: Depict quest rewards as seed packets being organized into one cozy garden path: Polli, wearing a tiny gardener hat, places a glowing Bonus reward card into a quest board while an old coupon booth is peacefully packed away. Include flowers and code-plants to show the simplified reward flow, with the familiar quest board as the central object.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden workshop where Polli, a cute pixel bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, and rounded translucent light-blue wings, wears a tiny gardener hat and pins a glowing "BONUS" reward card onto a wooden quest board beside blooming code-plants; a small old coupon booth is neatly folded away in the background. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
